title: The High Study
shortDescription: A high oak study above the Great Hall, kept for hard questions.
longDescription:
The High Study sits above the Great Hall. Oak beams take moonlight from a round window. A carved owl dais faces six small School banners. Ledgers wait in stacks. A tuning fork lies on the blotter.
Headmaster Alder does not smile first. The room smells of ink, dust, and old feathers. If he sent for you, it matters.

fixtures.name: Headmaster Alder
fixtures.lookDescription: An ancient snowy owl in a patched green robe, one yellow eye fierce, a scar across the other, a tuning fork at his belt. Try talk alder.
fixtures.examineDescription: Alder's facial disc is white. The scar is old. The robe is mended at the elbows. He listens to the end of a sentence. If he is speaking to you, he has already decided you can carry the answer.
fixtures.dialogue: "The Collegium trains woodland students. Choose a School. The bell below can wait until you are ready to stand with others."

welcome.text: "I am Alder. You will not find a house here. You will find a School. Ember, Thorns, the Veil, Stars, Stone, and Steel. Each is a craft. Pick one. The hearths open when you have chosen. The thing that tolls beneath us is not a lesson for the unschooled."

chosen-ember.text: "Ember. Fire that is held, not spilled. Your hearth is not open yet. Down returns you to the Great Hall. Do not waste the hours."

chosen-thorn.text: "Thorns. Growth that knows how to guard itself. Your hearth is not open yet. Down returns you to the Great Hall. Do not waste the hours."

chosen-veil.text: "The Veil. What is unseen still acts. Your hearth is not open yet. Down returns you to the Great Hall. Do not waste the hours."

chosen-stars.text: "Stars. Light that names a path. Your hearth is not open yet. Down returns you to the Great Hall. Do not waste the hours."

chosen-stone.text: "Stone. Patience that does not yield. Your hearth is not open yet. Down returns you to the Great Hall. Do not waste the hours."

chosen-steel.text: "Steel. A blade kept flat until it is needed. Your hearth is not open yet. Down returns you to the Great Hall. Do not waste the hours."

already-chosen.text: "You have a School. Finish first lessons at your hearth. The bell can wait until you can stand with others. Down, if you must wander."

offer-bell.text: "You have a School, and first lessons have your name. I am trusting you with the first honest question this school has asked in a long time. A deep bell sounds under our feet. The old abbey bell is gone — we have an empty frame to prove it. I will not invent a cause from a rumour. Examine the Empty Bell Frame in the Clock Tower, the Bell Ledger in the Archive Cellar, and the Listening Stone in the Quiet Chapel. Then return and talk alder here."

choices.label: I will examine the three places.

bell-why.text: "Which parts of the sound are true. Down to the Great Hall. The Clock Tower is east of the North Quad. The ledger is north of Library Stacks. The listening stone is west of the Herb Garden. Bring me facts, not a story."

bell-active.text: "Down to the Great Hall. Examine the Empty Bell Frame, the Bell Ledger, and the Listening Stone. Then talk alder here. I asked you because I need a Collegian who will look before they guess."

bell-done.text: "The wood remembers. That is enough for the first question. You did this school a service."

offer-wakes.text: "You already proved the wood can carry a welcome. Something below the Clock Tower has begun to answer. I would not send you down that stair if I had another pair of eyes I trusted. Piper Mole has been alone in the Silk Gallery too long, and he is afraid. Talk to him. Examine the Stair Rope, the Silk Thread, and the Waking Husk. Then return and talk alder here. Do not invent a queen from one hatchling."

choices.label: What am I looking for now?

wakes-why.text: "Whether anything down there has a mouth yet, and whether that mouth is still a child. East from the North Quad, then down. Piper keeps the gallery. The nave is east and south of him. Look. Name what you saw. I am counting on you."

wakes-active.text: "Down the Clock Tower. Talk piper. Examine the Stair Rope, the Silk Thread, and the Waking Husk. Then talk alder here. Finish this before the silk learns another name."

wakes-done.text: "A hatchling is not a queen. When three can stand together, we will ask what still sleeps. Go to class."

offer-sleeps.text: "Three can stand. South of the Cocoon Nave the cradle is no longer empty. I will not send one Collegian into that room. Take two classmates. Examine the Still Score. If she squares up, lock your moves on the same clock. Then return and talk alder here. This is the work I saved for students I trust to come home."

sleeps-why.text: "The next mouth after the hatchling. Not a throne. East from the North Quad, then down, east, south, and south again. Take two classmates. If she stands, lock together."

sleeps-active.text: "Together. South of the nave. Examine the Still Score. Lock your moves on one clock. Then talk alder here. The school is watching this one."

sleeps-done.text: "The silk has a mouth now, and it learned it from a class. That is enough. Go to class."

fixtures.name: School Chart
fixtures.examineDescription: Ember: a sheltered flame. Thorns: a leaf opening through a thorny branch. Veil: a silver moth. Stars: a clear constellation. Stone: a patient arch. Steel: a blade laid flat in an open hand. Beneath all six: Learn well. Use wisely. Leave room for others.
